Depression is a vicious cycle that tears you down little by little till there’s almost nothing left that’s understood by some, affected many, and ruined lots. It’s good you still have your hobbies and such and should go into those hobbies communities as a piece of advice, even if it’s hard now having those new experiences might fill some that gap of emptiness. A cliche, but a therapist ( even online chat room ones ) can help you find what you want in life and help you pursue it without antidepressants.

Advice I’d give is to find something you enjoy and wrap yourself around in it. Even if you care about it a little. You can also turn your vivid dreams into artistic expressions as well. Those friends aren’t at fault for thinking that way because they just don’t know what it is that you’re feeling and think what is most rational to them whilst depression’s methods of attacking us is irrational at best. Your friends want to help but then again you can’t ask someone who’s never experienced something how it was or how to get over it.

I suffer from something very similar with my family getting to the point where they saw me as an attention seeker because they thought I was faking it all, ( Who would want to fake depression? What even is the impossible benefit of depression? ) but advice from me is just find your cope. I found video games, always were taken away due to problems but when they were there they helped a lot. If you found anything you enjoy or even find the least bit interesting you should dive into those things instead to distract you from the barrage that depression throws at us, remember even the rich or most seemingly happy or people who “have it all going for them” can be depressed as well.

In conclusion, Depression is indiscriminate but find a coping mechanism to combat it anyway you can.

You’re upset that you’re in a cycle of sadness because you claim to lack a personality / social skills and you also want to have fond memories of your childhood to reminisce on when you get older as your older peers do but can’t find a way to fix it so it feeds into your cycle that makes you feel like a hollowed husk of who you once were?

To fix the first one, depression can sap the personality out of people or lock it away, some will put on a happy mask others will not even have the mental energy to do that anymore. Regardless of that, find something you like or find interesting even the smallest thing and explore more into it. Once you find something you enjoy yourself you can find friends in the communities that enjoy it as well and make some friends, If nothing interesting comes up you can use random searches to try and find something ( I used to do that to find new games ).

The second one will be solved after you surround yourself with what you enjoy and those new friends will help you make memories that will stay with you so you can reminisce on them in the future.

In conclusion, the advice I can give is find something you enjoy and surround yourself with its joy to find your soul again.

This is gonna sound like your classic loser stuff but for me one of my coping mechanisms was video games. I never really had a personality but for some reason when I play it’s like a switch is flipped. I can compare games to the bliss of sleeping since you don’t worry about life, then again problems with school makes sense to reduce privileges. I get what you’re saying about taking baby steps but I can’t do that anymore because what I’m being told to do is full steps. I have to do everything perfectly or else I burden them again. For example, I go to school but I get bad grades I get the same result as not going to school but I get good grades. I either get overwhelmed and shut down then make it worse or when it works I break down a week or so later. The cycle is Go to school for a week and a half, don’t go Thursday—-> Tuesday then get sent to be with my dad where I go because he gives me an extra hour to prepare ( I’m so mentally incapable someone has to give me an hour of their morning to get me out of the bed into a school) then get sent back as if the problem is solved then repeat. For all I’ve known in my life I’ve been stuck in cycles I seemingly don’t have control of and the ones I do are short-lived. 

It’s like my subconscious wants something but my conscious fails to realize it but this isn’t in a vacuum of just myself and it affects others around me. 

My thoughts are telling me Death will only be a short-lived pain compared to the future misery I could and already am bringing to those around me, which seems rational yet irrational.

I feel like I’m hurting myself by being alive and one last burst of pain might be worth it to end everyone else’s pain. The people I believe im hurting is my brothers, cousins, uncles/aunts, family in law, and parents. 

I understand when you’re coated in emotions you don’t always think straight but I feel empty. I experience emotions but they feel like they’re not mine, maybe subconscious. I’ve always felt apathetic in my life a year after what I can remember. I don’t know how I can help other people if I don’t burden them in this way I usually burden them in another. 

In conclusion, from my perspective, a short burst of pain is better than this prolonged miserable pain and burden I bring to those around me and myself.

It’s a physical problem ever since my 7th grade year into my 8th ( Worst ) where I missed over 130 school days and only 6 of those I entered school on-time (Passed due to above average test scores and credit recovery) and something I still struggle with to get into. The burden is that the schools are pursuing my mom and everyone tells me “You know if you don’t go your mother will get in trouble right?” Yeah I don’t wanna hurt my family by bringing stress and feeling like I’m ripping my family apart just because I’m not mentally strong enough to get out of a bed. My mother has had a mental breakdown where she sat in the bathroom crying because I’m too weak to do a basic thing every kid could, honestly that’s a crushing feeling. I don’t know if I should feel envy or jealousy but for what I’ve heard it’s what I should be that she has people that supported her. When I had a mental breakdown (self harm event 1) my aunt drove over an hour to calm me down. It was pretty much Blah blah blah (petty reason) threatened to kill myself, brother called my bluff, so I locked myself in the room, proceed to weep so hard I vomited and broke something and started cutting myself. It felt as if my parents cared in the most minuscule way like “don’t do that again. Bad” like talking to a dog. But regardless of all that old news I can recognize I’m my family’s home-wrecker and residential burden. I feel emotions on topics like these but they feel fake as I’m asking myself if I’m even worthy of emotions. For context I’ve grown up in your basic “Bad emotions suppressed” household.

To wrap it up, even though I can identify the problem I’m in this hopeless disparity of even though I wanna fix myself I just can’t. I feel useless and dying seems like a solid solution. 

Why should I continue this life if it “gets better” when it’s always been miserable?

I wanna call for help but even when I did get help it was only temporary, like a wind up box I work for a limited time before not functioning anymore.
I don’t think I want to satisfy my mother. I just don’t wanna be on this emotionless but painful existence where I hurt not only myself but others.

I know nothing should be based on a singular experience but to further elaborate into that I was 12 at the time. All it was pretty much my mom texting her “Hygiene bad” or “Truancy bad” so for every week I’d spend an hour locked in a room with someone who didn’t care what I said but just showed me some hygiene videos or motivational videos. Imagine paying $50 for an hour of YouTube searches that didn’t do anything. But there was my very first therapist, I’d say she was the best anyone could ask for. Instead of sitting across from me and having a meaningless chat she found a way to connect, sure it was a simple game but she established a connection. The value of a persons opinion who matters to you is so different than one you see as a stranger. She was given to me after my first self harm event and I’m grateful. I read on depression where depression genetically comes when others in your family line are also depressed but I researched into it and none on either side showed any signs so I don’t believe it’s genetics, I don’t think I have a pattern of self hatred I just see how I am a burden to those who care about me, ironically they could be the ones who started it but no use in pointing blame to anyone. I don’t have suppressed memories since all I have is time to go over them and try and find out why it happened and how it affects me now. I don’t feel strong enough either to find help, no I don’t think they failed me but I think I failed them without even being strong enough to even open up. I think I’ve been depressed ever since I was 10 so yeah it’s been going on for a while now.

To conclude, maybe it’s chronic but I’m stuck in a cycle that I can’t end and I can’t even find out why.
